subject: Billing split and VAT handling for Acme — entity allocation request
messages:
From: Emily Russo <emily.russo@acme-industries.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Cc: finance@acme-industries.com
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Split invoice between Acme EU & Acme US + VAT handling

Hi Karthik,

Hope you're well. We're ready to finalize the December invoice for our Redwood usage but need it split across two legal entities: Acme Industries EU (VAT-applicable) and Acme Holdings US (non-VAT). Our AP team needs:

- Separate invoice lines and totals by entity
- VAT shown and calculated only on the EU portion (23% VAT)
- Each invoice should include the respective tax/registration IDs (see attached sample)
- PO number: 45231 — please put this on both invoices with the appropriate cost center codes

Can Redwood produce split invoices (single billing run that exports two PDF invoices) or do we need separate billing profiles? Also please confirm we can allocate charges to cost centers: CC-EU-IT and CC-US-LLC.

I've attached our VAT certificate and PO. If you want a template, I can share a spreadsheet. Need to close this by Fri Dec 5 so our internal payment run can include it.

Thanks,
Emily Russo
Senior Finance Manager
Acme Industries

Attachments: ACME_VAT_certificate.pdf, PO_45231.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
To: Emily Russo <emily.russo@acme-industries.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example, neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoice between Acme EU & Acme US + VAT handling

Hi Emily — thanks for the details and the attachments. Looping in Sergio and Neha from Finance to confirm the best path. Quick answers up front:

- We can produce split invoices in a single billing run and generate two PDFs tied to the same subscription, or issue two separate invoices depending on your preference.
- VAT will be applied to the EU entity only — we will require the VAT registration number you attached (looks good at a glance).
- We can map line items to cost centers (CC-EU-IT, CC-US-LLC) as metadata on the invoice so your AP can allocate in your ledger.

Sergio / Neha — can you confirm process details: required fields for the invoice metadata, whether we should create two invoice documents or one combined document with split pages, and the expected timeline to have this ready for a Dec 5 payment run?

Emily — if you prefer, send the split_invoice_template.xlsx and we’ll populate and return the draft invoice PDFs for sign-off.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.example

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, Emily Russo <emily.russo@acme-industries.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoice between Acme EU & Acme US + VAT handling

Hi all — quick finance note:

1) Preferred format: Acme seems to need two PDF invoices (one per legal entity) to attach to each entity's AP system. We'll generate Invoice INV-2025-45231-EU and INV-2025-45231-US in one billing run.

2) Required fields from Acme: legal entity name, billing address, tax/VAT number (for EU), PO number, currency, and cost center code per line item.

3) VAT handling: we'll apply 23% VAT to lines assigned to the EU entity. We need the exact VAT reg number as it appears on official docs (good that Emily attached the certificate).

4) Timeline: if we receive the split_invoice_template.xlsx populated by end of day Wed Dec 3, Finance can produce draft invoices by Thu Dec 4 and send them for your approval. Final PDFs will be issued on Fri Dec 5 to match your payment run.

Neha — take point on building the invoice metadata and confirming the ledger mappings.

Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Finance Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Russo <emily.russo@acme-industries.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Cc: finance@acme-industries.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoice between Acme EU & Acme US + VAT handling

Thanks Karthik / Sergio — attached is the split_invoice_template.xlsx with the allocation by cost center. Key notes also included in the sheet:

- Lines 1-5 -> CC-EU-IT (to Acme Industries EU, VAT: GB999999999)
- Lines 6-10 -> CC-US-LLC (to Acme Holdings US, no VAT)
- Currency: EUR for EU lines, USD for US lines — please keep the invoice currency per entity
- Billing addresses and legal names are in tab "Entity Info"

Let me know if anything's missing. We expect to wire payment after you issue final PDFs on Dec 5.

Best,
Emily

Attachments: split_invoice_template.xlsx

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.example
To: Emily Russo <emily.russo@acme-industries.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Draft invoices ready for approval: INV-2025-45231-EU, INV-2025-45231-US

Hi Emily — attaching draft PDFs and a short mapping summary. Highlights:

- Two invoices created: INV-2025-45231-EU (EUR, VAT 23% on EU lines), INV-2025-45231-US (USD, no VAT).
- Each line item has a cost_center metadata field: CC-EU-IT or CC-US-LLC.
- PO 45231 appears on both invoices.
- We included your VAT certificate reference and tax ID on the EU invoice.

Please confirm by replying: APPROVE_DRAFT or REQUEST_CHANGES with line numbers. If approved, we'll finalize PDFs and generate the DocuSign/Download links by Fri 12/05.
